families.aggregation_comparability: Fixture observations are not intrinsically aggregatable; individual numeric facets may feed governed higher-grain derivations.
families.football_meaning: Identity, schedule, participants, score and match-centre evidence for one canonical fixture.
major_limitations: Optional enrichment is not equivalent to canonical fixture existence.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Fixture event time, correction history and source retrieval time must remain distinguishable.

families.aggregation_comparability: Event counts may be aggregated only after event type, identity and source completeness are established.
families.football_meaning: Chronological goals, cards, substitutions or commentary associated with one fixture.
major_limitations: PulseLive and FPL event structures are not automatically interchangeable.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Event time belongs to the match timeline; retrieval time is separate and does not prove when information first became available.

families.aggregation_comparability: Many count fields are summable, while percentages, rates and provider-specific definitions require explicit aggregation rules.
families.football_meaning: One team's measured performance in one fixture.
major_limitations: The historical events_stats source is team-match aggregate evidence, not a chronological event stream.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: A completed-match observation is historical state; information-availability time is not established by the value alone.

families.aggregation_comparability: Season totals are comparable only with schedule completeness, competition and denominator caveats made explicit.
families.football_meaning: A team's season-level totals, rates, record or standing components derived from fixture evidence.
major_limitations: The current URA has no separate atomic team-season source family; existing rows are derived through governed fixture queries.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Season-end values differ from season-to-date values and require an explicit as-of cut-off.

families.aggregation_comparability: Counts may be aggregated with verified player/fixture identity; rates and position-sensitive metrics need denominators and comparability review.
families.football_meaning: One player's participation or measured performance in one fixture or FPL gameweek observation.
major_limitations: Source player identifiers require the governed identity and relationship routes.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Completed-match evidence is historical state; FPL gameweek snapshots and match observations retain distinct source semantics.

families.aggregation_comparability: Source totals should not be re-summed across overlapping grains; cross-season and cross-position comparisons remain conditional.
families.football_meaning: A player's source-supplied or governed season aggregate.
major_limitations: Some player-season fields are retained but not yet semantically approved for reusable exposure.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: A season total needs an explicit season-end or season-to-date interpretation.

families.aggregation_comparability: League summaries are derived from a declared fixture population and must expose completeness and season scope.
families.football_meaning: League-wide standings, scoring environment, rankings and distributions for one season.
major_limitations: No generic league-wide variable family is currently exposed by URA.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Season-end and as-of league views are distinct; current league-table code is based on completed fixtures in the requested season.

families.aggregation_comparability: Identifiers and labels are not measures; contextual categories require declared grouping semantics.
families.football_meaning: Identity, venue, gameweek, score state, availability, profile and situational context used to interpret football observations.
major_limitations: Many raw configuration/profile fields remain semantically unclassified.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Context may describe event time, a snapshot, or pre-match state; those meanings must not be collapsed.

families.aggregation_comparability: Market values require bookmaker, market, selection and observation-time identity; the current calculator does not preserve such a history.
families.football_meaning: Explicit bookmaker price inputs and market-derived probabilities or edges.
major_limitations: FRL currently has no governed historical odds dataset.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Prediction time and market observation time are essential and are not persisted by the current user-input calculator.

families.aggregation_comparability: A derived metric inherits the comparability and coverage limits of every input and must be recomputed at the intended grain.
families.football_meaning: An FRL calculation whose source inputs and formula are explicitly identified.
major_limitations: Derived status does not create missing source evidence or remove source-rights dependencies.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: A derivation is only as-of safe as its latest input and construction order.

families.aggregation_comparability: Model outputs are comparable only within a declared model version, target population and prediction-time information set.
families.football_meaning: Outputs of an explicit predictive model, kept separate from observed football evidence.
major_limitations: Poisson V0.1 is a bounded current model, not a universal calibrated historical forecast archive.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Inputs knowable at prediction time must be distinguished from later outcomes; current Poisson V0.1 has fixed source/target seasons.

families.aggregation_comparability: Historical features may be compared when construction version, lookback window and as-of cut-off match.
families.football_meaning: Historical state constructed using only evidence available before a declared fixture or date cut-off.
major_limitations: URA request-time information availability remains distinct and is not inferred from ordinary historical observations.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: The V2 match-state artifact records feature_as_of and prior-fixture provenance; outcome columns are labels, not pre-match inputs.

families.aggregation_comparability: Not applicable as a football statistic.
families.football_meaning: Acquisition, transport, registry or provenance metadata retained to operate and audit FRL, not football performance evidence.
major_limitations: Must not be surfaced as a football variable merely because it appears in a raw payload.
families.temporal_as_of_semantics: Retrieval and capture timestamps are provenance times, not match-event or information-availability semantics.

schema.unknown_policy: Use UNKNOWN when evidence is absent and REVIEW_REQUIRED when evidence exists but its definition, route, comparability or rights status is not safely approved.

scope.statement: Governed capability metadata derived from existing FRL registries, artifacts and implemented research/model seams.

interpretation_notes: Variable records are capabilities, not a claim that every value is materialised for every fixture/season.
Capability-area counts overlap because one variable may serve more than one governed area.
UNKNOWN and REVIEW_REQUIRED are intentional fail-closed metadata values.
